title: OMEGA: physical Hormuz incident plus shadow-worker truth separation
net_new_delta: HORMUZ_MARITIME_INCIDENT_RISK is now backed by a physical tanker-strike report while restored-five local shadow evidence exposes explicit worker-receipt mismatch/missing states; physical incident risk and analytical/runtime authority must remain separately promoted.

rejected_findings: Do not infer Strait closure, petroleum-flow loss, attribution, or realized energy supply disruption from the tanker incident alone.
Do not treat local shadow model completion as native worker completion or substantive research.
Do not treat canonical peer acceptance as analytical or execution authority.
conflicts: Physical maritime incident risk increased, but measurable shipping/energy-flow impairment remains unverified.
Shadow inference completed while underlying worker receipts remain missing/mismatched; inference availability and worker execution health diverge.
blockers: Need independent evidence of traffic reduction/rerouting, freight or insurance repricing, or oil/LNG flow impairment before realized-supply promotion.
Need stage-level worker observability to locate scheduler->start->completion->receipt failure boundary.
